messages:
anya: Quick sync: I'm opening a PR to fix several errref pages about 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallbacks. Found stale links and old SDK snippets. Will standardize on Retry-After + X-RW-Retry-Policy headers and add a tiny node smoke test.

sam: Sounds good. Please add a short checklist in PR description and tag eng.

doc-bot: Link scan: 5 broken anchors under /errref; 2 snippets missing validate markers. Log: /tmp/errref-scan-4860.log

mike: I'll update Go snippet to use context.WithTimeout and show prompt trimming.

jess: I'll revise fallback copy. Suggest separate sections for model-variant vs capacity/region fallback behaviors.

anya: Draft curl example to include:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"short"}' "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate?model=redwood-vicuna-13b"
```
And note streaming: don't immediately retry on disconnect; use jittered backoff.

sam: When PR is up, ping me and I'll fast-track snippet validation.

anya: Will do. Adding label `docs:snippets-changed` per CI note. PR in ~30m.
